title: gdpr.erasure.requested
description: stapel-gdpr 0.5.0+ asks every data owner that claims subject_type to erase its slice. This module claims account only — every row it holds (sessions, refresh tokens, TOTP devices, passkeys, authenticator changes, login attempts, audit rows, SSO memberships, linked OAuth accounts, staff roles, step-up preferences) hangs off exactly one id, the user's — and ignores every other subject_type (gdpr creates no part for an owner that does not claim it). Documentation of what is consumed: the authoritative schema is the emitter's, in stapel-gdpr/schemas/emits/.
